title: Street Lamp/Light - New/Relocation
description: Use this service request to request additional street lighting or a street light where none has existed. Also, to relocate an existing street light. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

detailsForm.intro: *** If location is an Intersection ENTER in alpha order i.e. Akard @ Young ***

observedQuestions.question: What is the specific location of the street light for this request?
What side of street is the request for?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Specific location supplied; side = West; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact
detailsForm.contactStepObservation: First Name, Last Name, and Phone Number marked required

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a new street light or relocation of an existing light.
actions.why: For an additional street light, a light where none existed, or relocation of an existing street light. The 311 request form asks for the specific location and side of the street and says to enter intersection street names in alphabetical order.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Street Lamp/Light - New/Relocation"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Street Lamp/Light - New/Relocation"
